Skill Loom end to end: from a folder to a guarded run

Long image

A

Answer

Skill Loom is a loopback-only web app that turns installed agent skills into an ordered, preflighted chain, then runs each step in a server-owned terminal. The browser only exchanges typed API and WebSocket data; every file, process, and PTY operation stays in one Fastify server.12

  1. The server owns project registration, skill discovery, chain storage, preflight, runs, and PTYs.2
  2. Preflight re-runs at run creation and freezes the chain, inputs, mode, session plan, and harness.3
  3. A run keeps only a bounded tail and never replays a step after a reload.4
  4. Supervised steps wait for an explicit outcome; automatic steps wait for the harness signal, and silence pauses.5

Applies toSkill Loom 0.1.0single userOpenCode 2.2.5 and Copilot CLI 1.0.105

1

What runs where?

The browser is a client only. Fastify serves the built React app, the typed HTTP routes, and the terminal WebSocket from one loopback origin.

Diagram structure
  • Browser SPA browser
  • Fastify server api
  • Services services
  • JSON stores store
  • Server-owned PTY pty
  • Harness CLI harness
  • browser → api · HTTP and WS
  • api → services
  • services → store · read and write
  • services → pty · spawn
  • pty → harness · executable plus args
2

What happens from a project folder to a finished run?

Diagram structure
  • Register project project
  • Discover skills catalog
  • Build chain chain
  • Run preflight preflight
  • Freeze run snapshot freeze
  • Run step in PTY step
  • Mark outcome or signal advance
  • Write run record record
  • advance → record
  • catalog → chain
  • chain → preflight
  • freeze → step
  • preflight → freeze · start
  • project → catalog
  • step → advance · done or signal

The operator registers a folder, inspects what the chosen harness can load, and saves a chain. Preflight blocks bad states before any model call; run creation freezes the result. A blocked preflight returns to the chain, not to the model.

  1. Register project ↗

    Open or create a folder. Removing a recent entry never deletes project files.

  2. Discover skills ↗

    Pick a harness and read the skills it can load. Copy a package into the project if needed.

  3. Build chain ↗

    Bind one harness, add ordered steps, declare inputs, choose a session mode, and save.

  4. Run preflight ↗

    Check executable, auth, trust, catalog, inputs, session plan, permissions, and Git state.

  5. Start run ↗

    The server re-runs blocking checks, freezes the snapshot, and claims the active-run slot.

  6. Advance or recover ↗

    Supervised runs wait for an explicit outcome. Automatic runs wait for the signal; silence pauses.

3

How does one step reach the harness?

The adapter picks the command and process surface from the harness descriptor. A run route never checks a harness name.6

Diagram structure
  • Browser browser
  • Fastify routes api
  • Run orchestrator run
  • Harness adapter adapter
  • PTY and harness CLI pty
  • JSON run store store
  • browser → api · POST /api/projects/:id/runs
  • api → run · start run
  • run → store · freeze snapshot, claim active slot
  • run → adapter · build step command
  • adapter → run · executable plus args
  • run → pty · spawn without a shell
  • pty → run · output, exit, or OSC 7501 idle
  • run → store · status plus bounded tail
  • run → browser · snapshot and ordered deltas
4

Where do OpenCode and Copilot differ?

Both adapters expose the same preflight and run interfaces. Their command shapes, fork support, trust handling, and advancement signals differ.

ConcernOpenCode 2.2.5Copilot CLI 1.0.105
Skill discoveryFilesystem packages under .opencode/skillsCopilot project skills; the live probe used .agents/skills
Interactive entryopencode --session <id> --prompt <text> <dir>copilot -i <prompt> --session-id <id> -C <dir>
Headless entryopencode run [--fork] --session <id> <message>copilot -p <prompt> --session-id <id> -C <dir>
Fork mechanismNative --fork in headless; handoff in supervisedHandoff note only; the CLI has no fork flag
TrustNot read by Skill LoomReads trustedFolders read-only
Automatic advancementparser gapOSC 7501 working to idleHeadless process exit

Entry points come from the adapter descriptors.78

5

What keeps a run local, bounded, and honest?

Bind host
127.0.0.1; a non-loopback value aborts startup
Authentication
None; loopback is the boundary
Run tail
200 lines or 32 KiB per step
Active runs
One per config directory
Automatic step timeout
30 minutes, then pause
Data locations
~/.config/loom and <project>/.loom/
6

How do I verify a run behaved?

Order is prompt order, not a skill guarantee

Skills are model-invoked context. Skill Loom sends each step as a prompt, and the harness may decline to load a named skill. Automatic OpenCode advancement is unreliable today: the parser expects semicolon-separated OSC 7501 parameters, while OpenCode 2.2.5 sends colon-separated ones.
